name: The Jewel Store Job
summary: Michael's first heist, with Franklin and planner Lester: the Vangelico jewellery store. Two approaches: Smart (gas) and Loud. Maximum gross take is $4,946,153, from which Martin Madrazo is paid $2,500,000.

sections.title: Plan (Approach A: Smart / Approach B: Loud)
sections.text: Step 1: do Friend Request, then Casing the Jewel Store (Michael, garment factory in La Mesa). Step 2, Approach A (Smart): Bugstars Equipment then BZ Gas Grenades. Step 2, Approach B (Loud): Carbine Rifles. Step 3: also do the Masks setup if it appears (its heist is disputed). Step 4: choose gunman, driver and hacker (see crew cuts). Step 5: start the heist at the Vangelico store in Rockford Plaza. Condition: the crew you hire changes your cut and the chance of mistakes.

sections.title: Smart vs Loud
sections.text: Both approaches start with Casing the Jewel Store. Loud adds Carbine Rifles and is a direct armed entry; Smart adds Bugstars Equipment and BZ Gas Grenades and uses gas dropped through a vent to incapacitate the people inside.

sections.title: Payout
sections.text: The maximum gross take is $4,946,153 (three sites agree). From that, $2,500,000 goes to Martin Madrazo, leaving a maximum net take of $2,446,153 (Grand Theft Wiki); the same page gives Michael's maximum cut as $1,223,073 and Franklin's as $293,593 (12%).

sections.title: Crew (cuts as listed by Grand Theft Wiki)
sections.text: Gunmen: Gustavo Mota 14%, Packie McReary 12%, Norm Richards 10.5% (his role is scripted to crash and may lose diamonds). Drivers: Eddie Toh 14%, Karim Denz 8%. Hackers: Paige Harris 15%, Christian Feltz 10%, Rickie Lukens 4%.

sections.title: Which crew? (opinion, guides disagree)
sections.text: The guides disagree. GTAIntel recommends Karim Denz (driver) + Norm Richards (gunman) with the Smart approach for a balanced cut; Destructoid's maximum-payout route uses Rickie Lukens (hacker), Packie McReary (gunman) and Karim Denz (driver). Better-skilled crew take a larger cut but make fewer mistakes.

sections.title: Unlocks
sections.text: Completing the heist unlocks the mission Mr. Philips. Per Grand Theft Wiki, switching between Michael and Franklin is unavailable afterwards until Friends Reunited is completed.

name: The Merryweather Heist
summary: Trevor leads Michael and Franklin in stealing an experimental device from Merryweather at the Port of Los Santos. Approaches: Freighter (Minisub setup) and Offshore (Cargobob setup). The device has to be handed back, so the crew keeps no payout.

sections.title: Plan (Approach A: Freighter / Approach B: Offshore)
sections.text: Step 1: Scouting the Port as Trevor (port of Los Santos, disguised as a dock worker). Step 2, Approach A (Freighter): Minisub. Step 2, Approach B (Offshore): Cargobob at Fort Zancudo. Step 3: run The Merryweather Heist. Condition: the device has to be handed back, so no cash is kept.

sections.title: Freighter vs Offshore
sections.text: Scouting the Port comes first. The Freighter approach uses the Minisub setup; the Offshore approach uses the Cargobob setup (the Cargobob mission page says it is only needed for Offshore).

sections.title: Payout
sections.text: Grand Theft Wiki says the device would have been worth $20 million, but it has to be returned, so the heist yields no payout; Destructoid also treats it as botched with no crew optimisation possible.

name: Blitz Play
summary: Michael, Franklin and Trevor ambush a Securicar carrying bonds using a Trashmaster and a tow truck, then hold off the LSPD. Steve Haines is the mission giver. There is no crew choice and no cash payout is listed.

sections.title: Plan (single approach)
sections.text: Step 1: complete The Merryweather Heist. Step 2: do the setups Trash Truck (Mirror Park), Boiler Suits (Ammu-Nation, Strawberry), Masks, Tow Truck (La Puerta) and Getaway Vehicle. Step 3: Blitz Play: block the street with the Trashmaster, take the Securicar with the tow truck, hold off the LSPD. Condition: there is no crew choice and no cash payout is listed.

sections.title: How it unlocks
sections.text: Finish The Merryweather Heist, then complete the five setup missions given by Michael: Trash Truck, Boiler Suits, Masks, Tow Truck and Getaway Vehicle (Blitz Play). Steve Haines then gives Blitz Play. (A Hood Safari page claims to unlock it as well — the pages disagree.)

sections.title: Payout
sections.text: Destructoid lists Blitz Play as having no monetary payout; the Grand Theft Wiki page lists no cash reward either.

name: The Paleto Score
summary: Michael, Franklin and Trevor rob the Blaine County Savings Bank in Paleto Bay and fight off police and military. Setup missions: Paleto Score Setup and Military Hardware. Maximum take $8,016,020, split among the crew.

sections.title: Plan (single approach)
sections.text: Step 1: Paleto Score Setup (Michael and Trevor scout the Blaine County Savings Bank with Lester). Step 2: Military Hardware (intercept a military convoy near Harmony). Step 3: hire one gunman. Step 4: The Paleto Score at the Paleto Bay bank. Condition: Daryl Johns or Norm Richards may die if hired.

sections.title: Payout
sections.text: The maximum take is $8,016,020 (Grand Theft Wiki and GTA5Wiki agree), subject to losses from gunfire. Grand Theft Wiki lists $444,206 for each protagonist and $210,414 each for the gunman and Lester; Destructoid gives a range of roughly $425,000–$464,000 per character depending on performance.

sections.title: Crew
sections.text: One gunman is chosen from Daryl Johns, Norm Richards, Packie McReary, Chef or Gustavo Mota; Lester handles the escape boat. Daryl Johns or Norm Richards can die if chosen.

sections.title: Gold Medal / secondary objectives
sections.text: Gold-medal time limit 16 minutes; secondary objectives include firing over 4,000 bullets, 50%+ accuracy and causing $1,000,000+ of damage in Paleto Bay.

name: The Bureau Raid
summary: Michael and Franklin raid the FIB building for Steve Haines to destroy evidence. Two approaches: covert (Fire Crew, with the Fire Truck setup) and Roof (assault). Payout figures disagree between sources.

sections.title: Plan (Approach A: Fire Crew / Approach B: Roof)
sections.text: Step 1: Cleaning Out the Bureau (follow the janitor), Reuniting the Family, then Architect's Plans (Franklin, Mile High Club site). Step 2, Approach A (Fire Crew): Fire Truck and Getaway Vehicle, two gunmen. Step 2, Approach B (Roof): NOOSE gear, pilot, gunman, hacker and driver. Step 3: The Bureau Raid at the FIB building. Condition: approach names differ between pages (Covert / Fire Crew; Roof).

sections.title: Covert (Fire Crew) vs Roof
sections.text: Grand Theft Wiki lists a Covert approach (setups: Architect's Plans, Fire Truck, Getaway Vehicle; two gunmen) and a Roof approach (Architect's Plans plus NOOSE equipment; crew: pilot, gunman, hacker and driver). The Fire Truck mission page calls the covert route the Fire Crew approach.

sections.title: Secondary objectives
sections.text: Covert: finish within 18:00, escape with 40% oxygen, finish the mopping within 3 minutes, abseil down the elevator shaft within 30 seconds. Roof: finish within 19:00, no civilian casualties, 20+ headshots, 70%+ accuracy, perfect roof landing, hack within 45 seconds.

sections.title: Payout
sections.text: The Grand Theft Wiki page gives no payout. Destructoid quotes about $240,000 for Franklin with its crew; other sources quote different figures. Treat the payout as unconfirmed.

sections.title: Unlocks
sections.text: Completing it leads to The Wrap Up.

name: The Big Score
summary: The final heist: the Union Depository job planned in Planning the Big Score. Subtle (Stingers + Gauntlet; needs a hacker) or Obvious (Driller + Sidetracked). Guides quote 40+ million dollars per protagonist with an optimised crew.

sections.title: Plan (Approach A: Subtle / Approach B: Obvious)
sections.text: Step 1: Surveying the Score and Planning the Big Score (Vanilla Unicorn). Step 2, Approach A (Subtle): Stingers (Davis police station) and Gauntlet; hire 2 gunmen, 2 drivers and a hacker. Step 2, Approach B (Obvious): Driller (La Mesa) and Sidetracked (Davis Quartz train station); hire 2 gunmen and 2 drivers. Step 3: Getaway Vehicle. Step 4: The Big Score at the Union Depository. Condition: sources disagree on which approach pays more.

sections.title: Subtle vs Obvious
sections.text: Subtle: intercept Securicars posing as Gruppe 6 guards and move the gold into modified Gauntlets; it needs 2 gunmen, 2 drivers and a hacker. Obvious: create a diversion while drilling up to the vault and extract the gold by helicopter to a train; it needs 2 gunmen and 2 drivers (no hacker). Grand Theft Wiki and GTABase agree on these crew requirements.

sections.title: Payout
sections.text: Two guides state that an optimised crew yields over $41 million per protagonist; GTAIntel puts the total at about $201 million. The figures are approximate and depend on crew cuts and performance.

sections.title: Crew cuts (sample)
sections.text: GTABase lists Taliana Martinez (driver) 5%, Daryl Johns (gunman) 6%, Karim Denz (driver) 8% and Paige Harris (hacker) 15%. GTAIntel says Taliana is unlocked via a side mission.

sections.title: Which approach pays more? (opinion, guides disagree)
sections.text: GTABase argues Obvious yields the highest revenue because crew costs are lower and Subtle needs a $300,000 bribe; GTAIntel recommends Subtle with Paige Harris. The sources diverge, so this is an open opinion question.
